title: fix(OpenAPI): OpenAPI spec creation not working

target.summary: buildSpecVariables includes process environment variables and environment variables when generating OpenAPI specifications. When creating an API spec from a collection, secrets and environment variables are interpolated into the output, leaking sensitive credentials into the exported spec.
notes: faulty function injecting process and environment variables into spec variables
call site passing process and workspace environment variables to buildSpecVariables
helper that decrypts stored environment secrets for spec export
reads .env variables to populate processEnvVariables for spec export
call site decrypting environment secrets into exported environment variables
